sentences.text:
The petitioners identify themselves to be the owners of land in village Bijarni, tehsil Bhagwah,
district Doda.

The petitioners' case is that their land has come under purported acquisition for the purpose of construction of road from Beer Bagh to Kanhal in village Bijarni, tehsil Bhagwah, district Doda but the official respondents i.e., the Collector Land Acquisition has so far as not initiated any land acquisition exercise under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners draws attention to annexure-II to the writ petition which is a communication from the Collector Land Acquisition, Doda to Executive Engineer, PWD (R&B)
Special Division, Doda with respect to exchange of field book/tatima shajra of the land required to be acquired for construction of the road.
